templates.title: Bold sale announcement
templates.description: An editorial sale post: one giant word, a round discount sticker in a single loud accent and a clear button.

templates.title: Serif quote card
templates.description: A calm, neutral quote post: an oversized quotation mark, a serif quote with plenty of space and a small author line.

templates.title: Rooftop event story
templates.description: A photo-led event story at dusk: a big rounded photo, a serif title, the date, time and place, and an RSVP button inside the safe zone.

templates.title: Modern pitch deck
templates.description: A calm, editorial 16:9 pitch deck in cream, ink and deep green: a cover with a photo, a slide of big numbers and a closing slide.

templates.title: Night Bloom concert poster
templates.description: A type-led gig poster for 18 x 24 in print: the headliner huge, the support acts and details in a clear hierarchy, and a halftone sun.

templates.title: Grand opening flyer
templates.description: A warm, minimal café opening flyer for US Letter: an arched photo, a serif headline, an opening-day offer and the details in one row.

templates.title: Botanical celebration invitation
templates.description: A quiet, elegant 5 x 7 in wedding invitation: linen paper, a soft arch with greenery, script names and an RSVP QR code.

templates.title: Modern resume
templates.description: A clean single-column A4 resume with one accent colour, easy for people and resume parsers to read: profile, experience, education and skills.

templates.title: Bold YouTube thumbnail
templates.description: A high-contrast before-and-after thumbnail: a huge number, three words, two photos and an arrow, all clear of the edges.

templates.title: Clean business card
templates.description: A type-first two-sided business card: your name large on the front with the contact details, and a giant initial with a QR code on the back.
